title: 🖐️ Retro Player / One Hand + Eye Pet

accepted_baseline.label: Persistent low-res first-person scene
preserve: one coherent generated photographic hand identity

current_candidate.summary: V11 replaces the pet mask head with the generated monochrome eye-frame animation. The eyelid/liner sprite is a separate transparent layer, while the eyeball/pupil is rendered independently behind it. Idle blinks are occasional; petting forces one blink.

open_feedback: Verify the published eye frame reads like the approved black/white retro design rather than a generic symbol.
Verify the pupil/eyeball is clearly behind the transparent eye frame and disappears naturally during the blink.
Verify the blink cadence is calm and not over-animated.
Tune only eye scale, pupil size, blink speed or contrast from real page feedback before activating any other rows from the generated 10x10 grid.
